1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One broad shadow cap among three widely separated specimen responses; slow motion and strong camera damping.
1.natural_language: Test each lamp on its rail; one shadow follows your shift late. Track its dashed end cap with the aperture. Build all exposures together to 6s; lost contact fades and can recover. An honest exposure, incomplete filing or the 120s scan limit ends the episode.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Smaller specimen caps, faster motion and a shorter response lag require closer tracking.
2.natural_language: Test each lamp on its rail; one shadow follows your shift late. Track its dashed end cap with the aperture. Build all exposures together to 6s; lost contact fades and can recover. An honest exposure, incomplete filing or the 120s scan limit ends the episode.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Four possible shadow responses share the changing lamp; faster lamp motion and weaker camera damping.
3.natural_language: Test each lamp on its rail; one shadow follows your shift late. Track its dashed end cap with the aperture. Build all exposures together to 6s; lost contact fades and can recover. An honest exposure, incomplete filing or the 120s scan limit ends the episode.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Two separate changing lamps and cameras require maintaining two fading exposures at once.
4.natural_language: Test each lamp on its rail; one shadow follows your shift late. Track its dashed end cap with the aperture. Build all exposures together to 6s; lost contact fades and can recover. An honest exposure, incomplete filing or the 120s scan limit ends the episode.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Ten independently moving specimen responses, two different lamp histories, small end caps and weaker damping require simultaneous diagnosis, prediction and correction.
5.natural_language: Test each lamp on its rail; one shadow follows your shift late. Track its dashed end cap with the aperture. Build all exposures together to 6s; lost contact fades and can recover. An honest exposure, incomplete filing or the 120s scan limit ends the episode.

full.summary: Drag a live lamp along its test rail to inspect shadow response; drag each camera ring to aim. Existing inertia, geometry and film evolution are preserved. Repeat lamp tests freely; every response record remains selectable without pausing the scene.

simplified.summary: Click a live lamp test rail to inspect the same response; click elsewhere in a table to aim its camera. The same lamp shift, geometry, inertia and film evolution apply. Repeat lamp tests freely; every response record remains selectable without pausing the scene.
